async def check_update(dev: Device, internet: bool, update: bool):
    """Print out update information."""
    if not internet:
        _LOGGER.warning(
            "Unable to check for updates. No internet connection available."
        )
        return

    if not update:
        _LOGGER.info("Skipping update check.")
        return

    try:
        latest_version = await dev.async_get_latest_version()
    except DeviceException as err:
        _LOGGER.warning("Unable to check for updates: %s", err)
        return

    if latest_version is None:
        _LOGGER.warning("Unable to check for updates.")
        return

    if latest_version == dev.version:
        _LOGGER.info("You are running the latest version of %s", dev.name)
        return

    _LOGGER.info(
        "There is a new version of %s available. Your version is %s, the latest version is %s",
        dev.name,
        dev.version,
        latest_version,
    )
